maddeler.e:
يحرنجم (form IIIq)
# يَحْرَنْجِمُ (yaḥranjimu) /jaħ.ran.d͡ʒi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# يُحْرَنْجَمُ (yuḥranjamu) /juħ.ran.d͡ʒa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# يَحْرَنْجِمَ (yaḥranjima) /jaħ.ran.d͡ʒi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
